verses.original: וָאָשֻׁ֗ב וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָֽאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבַּ֤ע מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ יֹֽצְא֔וֹת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וְהֶהָרִ֖ים הָרֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·šuḇ wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh ’ar·ba‘ mar·kā·ḇō·wṯ yō·ṣə·’ō·wṯ mib·bên šə·nê he·hā·rîm wə·he·hā·rîm hā·rê nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: And again I lifted up my eyes and saw . . . four chariots coming out from between two mountains mountains . . . of bronze
verses.literalPt: E OUTRA vez levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis que quatro carros saiam dentre dois montes, e estes montes eram montes de bronze.

verses.original: בַּמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הָרִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית סוּסִ֥ים שְׁחֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bam·mer·kā·ḇāh hā·ri·šō·nāh sū·sîm ’ă·ḏum·mîm ū·ḇam·mer·kā·ḇāh haš·šê·nîṯ sū·sîm šə·ḥō·rîm
verses.literal: The first chariot had red horses the second black horses
verses.literalPt: No primeiro carro eram cavalos vermelhos, e no segundo carro, cavalos pretos,

verses.original: וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית סוּסִ֣ים לְבָנִ֑ים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָה֙ הָרְבִעִ֔ית סוּסִ֥ים בְּרֻדִּ֖ים אֲמֻצִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇam·mer·kā·ḇāh haš·šə·li·šîṯ sū·sîm lə·ḇā·nîm ū·ḇam·mer·kā·ḇāh hā·rə·ḇi·‘îṯ sū·sîm bə·rud·dîm ’ă·muṣ·ṣîm
verses.literal: the third white horses and the fourth dappled horses all of them strong
verses.literalPt: E no terceiro carro, cavalos brancos, e no quarto carro, cavalos malhados, todos eram fortes.

verses.original: וָאַ֙עַן֙ וָֽאֹמַ֔ר אֶל־ הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י מָה־ אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’a·‘an wā·’ō·mar ’el- ham·mal·’āḵ had·dō·ḇêr bî māh- ’êl·leh ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: So I inquired of the angel who was speaking with me What are these my lord
verses.literalPt: E respondi, dizendo ao anjo que falava comigo: Que é isto, senhor meu?

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑י אֵ֗לֶּה אַרְבַּע֙ רֻח֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם יוֹצְא֕וֹת מֵֽהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ אֲד֥וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ham·mal·’āḵ way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy ’êl·leh ’ar·ba‘ ru·ḥō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim yō·wṣ·’ō·wṯ mê·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- ’ă·ḏō·wn kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And the angel told me These are the four spirits of heaven going forth from their station before the Lord of all the earth
verses.literalPt: E o anjo respondeu, dizendo-me: Estes são os quatro espíritos do céu, saindo donde estavam perante o Senhor de toda a terra.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֞הּ הַסּוּסִ֣ים הַשְּׁחֹרִ֗ים יֹֽצְאִים֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְהַלְּבָנִ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל־ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨בְּרֻדִּ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- bāh has·sū·sîm haš·šə·ḥō·rîm yō·ṣə·’îm ’el- ’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nîm yā·ṣə·’ū ’el- ’a·ḥă·rê·hem wə·hab·bə·rud·dîm yā·ṣə·’ū ’el- ’e·reṣ hat·tê·mān
verses.literal: The one with the black horses is going toward the land of the north the one with the white horses toward the west and the one with the dappled horses toward the south
verses.literalPt: O carro em que estão os cavalos pretos, sai para a terra do norte, e os brancos saem atrás deles, e os malhados saem para a terra do sul.

verses.original: וְהָאֲמֻצִּ֣ים יָצְא֗וּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ לְהִתְהַלֵּ֣ך בָּאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְכ֖וּ הִתְהַלְּכ֣וּ בָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּתְהַלַּ֖כְנָה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·muṣ·ṣîm yā·ṣə·’ū way·ḇaq·šū lā·le·ḵeṯ lə·hiṯ·hal·lēḵ bā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·mer lə·ḵū hiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū ḇā·’ā·reṣ wat·tiṯ·hal·laḵ·nāh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: As the strong horses went out they were eager to go and patrol the earth and the LORD said Go and patrol the earth So they patrolled the earth
verses.literalPt: E os cavalos fortes saíam, e procuravam ir por diante, para percorrerem a terra. E ele disse: Ide, percorrei a terra. E percorreram a terra.

verses.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֣ק אֹתִ֔י וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר רְאֵ֗ה הַיּֽוֹצְאִים֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן הֵנִ֥יחוּ אֶת־ רוּחִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ צָפֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaz·‘êq ’ō·ṯî way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lay lê·mōr rə·’êh hay·yō·wṣ·’îm ’el- ’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn hê·nî·ḥū ’eṯ- rū·ḥî bə·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: Then the LORD summoned me . . . and said Behold those going . . . to the land of the north have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north
verses.literalPt: E chamou-me, e falou-me, dizendo: Eis que aqueles que saíram para a terra do norte fizeram repousar o meu Espírito na terra do norte.

verses.literal: The word of the LORD also came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E a palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo:

verses.original: לָק֙וֹחַ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מֵחֶלְדַּ֕י וּמֵאֵ֥ת טוֹבִיָּ֖ה וּמֵאֵ֣ת יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה וּבָאתָ֤ אַתָּה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וּבָ֗אתָ בֵּ֚ית יֹאשִׁיָּ֣ה בֶן־ צְפַנְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖אוּ מִבָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·qō·w·aḥ mê·’êṯ hag·gō·w·lāh mê·ḥel·day ū·mê·’êṯ ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh ū·mê·’êṯ yə·ḏa‘·yāh ū·ḇā·ṯā ’at·tāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ū·ḇā·ṯā bêṯ yō·šî·yāh ḇen- ṣə·p̄an·yāh ’ă·šer- bā·’ū mib·bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Take an offering from the exiles from Heldai . . . Tobijah . . . and Jedaiah who have arrived from Babylon and go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah
verses.literalPt: Toma dos que foram levados cativos, a saber, de Heldai, de Tobias e de Jedaías, os quais vieram de Babilônia, e vem tu no mesmo dia, e entra na casa de Josias, filho de Sofonias.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ כֶֽסֶף־ וְזָהָ֖ב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עֲטָר֑וֹת וְשַׂמְתָּ֗ בְּרֹ֛אשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ḵe·sep̄- wə·zā·hāḇ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘ă·ṭā·rō·wṯ wə·śam·tā bə·rōš yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ben- yə·hō·w·ṣā·ḏāq hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Take silver and gold make an ornate crown and set it on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak
verses.literalPt: Toma, digo, prata e ouro, e faze coroas, e põe-nas na cabeça do sumo sacerdote Josué, filho de Jozadaque.

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּה־ אִ֞ישׁ צֶ֤מַח שְׁמוֹ֙ וּמִתַּחְתָּ֣יו יִצְמָ֔ח וּבָנָ֖ה אֶת־ הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lê·mōr hin·nêh- ’îš ṣe·maḥ šə·mōw ū·mit·taḥ·tāw yiṣ·māḥ ū·ḇā·nāh ’eṯ- hê·ḵal ha·šēm
verses.literal: And you are to tell him . . . that this is what . . . the LORD of Hosts says Here is a man whose name is the Branch and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E fala-lhe, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Eis aqui o homem cujo nome é RENOVO; ele brotará do seu lugar, e edificará o templo do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְ֠הוּא יִבְנֶ֞ה אֶת־ הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וְהֽוּא־ יִשָּׂ֣א ה֔וֹד וְיָשַׁ֥ב וּמָשַׁ֖ל עַל־ כִּסְא֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה כֹהֵן֙ עַל־ כִּסְא֔וֹ וַעֲצַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹם תִּהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yiḇ·neh ’eṯ- hê·ḵal Yah·weh wə·hū- yiś·śā hō·wḏ wə·yā·šaḇ ū·mā·šal ‘al- kis·’ōw wə·hā·yāh ḵō·hên ‘al- kis·’ōw wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ šā·lō·wm tih·yeh bên šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Yes, He will build the temple of the LORD He will be clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule And He will be a priest on His throne and there will be peaceful counsel between the two
verses.literalPt: Ele mesmo edificará o templo do SENHOR, e ele levará a glória; assentar-se-á no seu trono e dominará, e será sacerdote no seu trono, e conselho de paz haverá entre ambos os ofícios.

verses.original: וְהָעֲטָרֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶה֙ לְחֵ֙לֶם֙ וּלְטוֹבִיָּ֣ה וְלִידַֽעְיָ֔ה וּלְחֵ֖ן בֶּן־ צְפַנְיָ֑ה לְזִכָּר֖וֹן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ă·ṭā·rōṯ tih·yeh lə·ḥê·lem ū·lə·ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh wə·lî·ḏa‘·yāh ū·lə·ḥên ben- ṣə·p̄an·yāh lə·zik·kā·rō·wn bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh
verses.literal: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem Tobijah Jedaiah and the gracious son of Zephaniah
verses.literalPt: E estas coroas serão para Helém, e para Tobias, e para Jedaías, e para Hem, filho de Sofonias, como um memorial no templo do SENHOR.

verses.original: וּרְחוֹקִ֣ים׀ יָבֹ֗אוּ וּבָנוּ֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ אִם־ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·ḥō·w·qîm yā·ḇō·’ū ū·ḇā·nū bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·mə·‘ūn bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you This will happen if you diligently obey . . . the voice of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E aqueles que estão longe virão, e edificarão no templo do SENHOR, e vós sabereis que o SENHOR dos Exércitos me tem enviado a vós; e isto sucederá assim, se diligentemente ouvirdes a voz do SENHOR vosso Deus.
